payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance metrics of the NAKDIMON system on different test sets, including the DICTA test set and a new test set, specifically regarding character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR).

claims.text: The difference in performance between the DICTA test set and the new test set can be attributed to the training data used for NAKDIMON, which was not trained on the DICTA portion, affecting its accuracy on the WOR metric.

NAKDIMON shows a higher character accuracy (CHA) compared to word accuracy (WOR), indicating that while individual characters may be correctly identified, the overall word accuracy suffers due to errors in multiple characters.

The performance difference in WOR scores between the two test sets may also be influenced by the types of errors, with a significant portion of errors being vocalization-agnostic, which affects the overall accuracy.
